questions.q: What disaster has stripped the land in chapter 1?
Who does Joel tell to wake up and weep because the sweet wine is cut off?
What does Joel say the invading nation's teeth are like?
What does Joel say has been cut off from the LORD's house?
options: The meal offering and drink offering

questions.q: Joel tells the land to mourn like whom?
options: A virgin in sackcloth for the husband of her youth
A widow weeping at the city gate
A mother mourning her only son
A shepherd who has lost his flock

Tell your children about it, and have your children tell ____, and their children, another generation.

Joel calls on the priests to put on sackcloth and mourn.
Joel says the herds groan because enemy soldiers carried them off as plunder.
Where does Joel say to blow the trumpet and sound an alarm?
What does God promise to pour out on all flesh?
How is the land described before and behind the great army?
options: Like Eden before them, a wilderness behind
A wilderness before them, Eden behind
Like a sea before them, dry behind

questions.q: How does the army get into the houses?
options: In at the windows like thieves

questions.q: Where are the priests told to weep?
options: Between the porch and the altar
At the gate of the city
On the steps of the palace

questions.q: Tear your heart and ____, and turn to the LORD, your God.

The chapter says whoever calls on the LORD's name will be saved.

Where does God say he will gather all nations for judgment?
Which peoples does God ask, Will you repay me?
To whom had the children of Judah been sold?
What does the chapter say will flow out from the LORD's house?
Beat your plowshares into swords, and ____ into spears.
Multitudes, multitudes in ____! For the day of the LORD is near.
Put in the sickle; for ____. Come, tread, for the wine press is full.
The chapter says the LORD will be a refuge to his people and a stronghold to Israel.
